text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy delivered a brilliant performance,
leaving her mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then one day.
While walking down the street with Zenno Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy-oneechan!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eep!!
Ah... huh?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waah, it's the real deal...!!
Awesome, awesome, Rob Roy-oneechan!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh? Um...?
choice_data_list: I think I might be one of your fans now?
Aren't they a fan of yours?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-Is... that so?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I went to see the Arima Kinen
with Mama, too!!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! Congrats on 1st place.
And also... and... umm...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
And...?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: And also... and also, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are!!
Jeez, running off out of nowhere like that...!!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Zenno Rob Roy-san?!
I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to barge in...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, n-no...! It's fine, just like this!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay.
Even if you feel shy, if you speak slowly...
everyone will listen properly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, you know?
How can I become like you, Big Sis?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Like me...?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I want to be just like my big sister...
Strong and cool.

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But... I really can't handle feeling embarrassed.
I get all overwhelmed... and my legs start shaking.
That's why I can never win any races...

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still...
I want to become just like Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...What's the right way to respond to that...?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Sticking to your will, forging your own destiny, standing out no matter what, training hard, never giving up, crying once in a while...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...You know what? I'll let you in on something special.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: No matter how chaotic and unsightly the trail may be—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "To accept your own story, and to love it."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Surely, just that alone... will be enough.
